summary.text: Bradley Macrae is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Grafton 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Ella Barrett in a race with no incumbent.
On his campaign website he describes himself as a Dorchester small business owner whose family runs a working farm.

paragraphs.text: Bradley Macrae says on his campaign website that he lives in Dorchester and has been self-employed as an entrepreneur for two decades, building and operating businesses in farming, agriculture and health products.
He also says he spent four years as a volunteer firefighter and first responder, and that this is his first foray into politics, though he had recently begun serving as a Dorchester selectman.
Macrae lists tax relief without new statewide taxes as the focus of his campaign, along with expanding Educational Freedom Accounts, reducing regulation, and local control.
